# Data Sources and Labels {#sec-data-sources-and-labels}

Part I already covers where the data comes from (the funnel and notifications in The Auction Lifecycle, postbacks, attribution, and data rights in Measurement and MMPs, device profiles and the bid ledger in Inside a DSP). This chapter is the hands-on version: turning those sources into labeled training examples. Placement and scope to be settled in the Part II restructure.
